author: More Perfect Union
description:
Kevin O’Leary claims people opposing his massive Utah data center are being “bussed in.”

But we talked to the protesters. They’re locals, and they’re pissed at this multimillionaire swooping in.

"I don't understand why Utah is letting a Canada company come in and take advantage of us.”

Producer: Court Fuller
Editor: Tobias Nikl
Videographer: Austin Smock
title: Kevin O'Leary's data center would be the largest in the world
